notes.title: The Withering - Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
The Withering - Transition from Early Access to Full Release

Hello everybody! As we announced in our previous update, we were working on stabilizing the build and preparing for a transition to a Full Release state.

Full Release State

The Withering is now officially in Full Release state!

With this transition we are planning to expand our community by taking advantage of all the features that Steam platform offers. We are looking forward to invite new active players that will contribute to the community.

Now that the game is in Full Release, does it mean the development will stop?

No! The development will continue as planned, with additional content being released in two upcoming updates, according to the schedule.

The first update that will introduce the new game mechanic where players will encounter survivor hideout during their Scavenging missions in the City. The new mechanic will allow players to either intimidate the survivors and attempt to extort them for loot, or gain their trust and attain a favor for future use in the Camp Management gameplay phase.

The update is scheduled for next week.

New Content

With this update we are introducing the new Steam platform content. Player will now be able to take advantage of our brand new Trading Cards system that becomes active immediately after this release!

Additionally, the new Steam Achievements system is also becoming active with this update. The brand new 20 Achievements for players to unlock are activated immediately with this release.

Patch Notes

Expansions:
* Infected AI system has been expanded to support the new mechanics
* Enemy AI system has been expanded to support the new mechanics
* Player controller has been reworked to support the additions of new content

Technical:
* Steamworks API implemented and configured
* AI control systems stabilized
* Player control systems stabilized
* Inventory systems updated
* Loading times decreased
* Dynamic scene loading optimized for Exploration map
* Physics processing optimized for Exploration map to increase performance
* Overall performance optimization throughout various game mechanics


Feedback

http://steamcommunity.com/app/427950/discussions/0/2741975115076574273/

notes.title: The Withering 2.0 - Development Update #8
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I would like to share with you the news on the free roam development. What was achieved so far and the short term development plan.

First things first, I have good news..and I have GREAT news! :)

During the course of the last couple of weeks, I was able to successfully develop and implement the new technical solution that will manage the free roam gameplay locations, by dynamically loading and unloading the assets. This mechanic was developed, tested and successfully implemented into the gameplay.

Additionally, I wanted to go a bit further. I was able to breakdown the locations into subsections and adjust the mechanic to gradually process these sections. This approach allowed for smoother transition in and out of a location and also ensure that no excessive loading is done on runtime.

Players will now be able to see the location from afar, but the details will only be loaded into memory if a player decides to visit that location.

Another success that I wanted to talk about is the navigation solution for NPCs. The navigation is now being dynamically loaded with the location. This will reduce the global free roam loading times and the required size on disk.

To top it all off, I successfully adjusted the existing visual properties of the player camera to allow for the new free roam features. The new visuals will ensure a smooth transition between the horizon and visible terrain / objects.

Additionally, I was able to adjus the free roam environment processing to allow for even more details. More rocks, stones, trees and grass which makes the new map look even more glorious.

Now that we have these mechanics in place, and I have successfully implemented a universal solution, I will be focusing on populating the new free roam map with locations, events and other gameplay elements.

I will update this announcement with new screenshots later tonight to show off the new mechanics and looks.

Thank you!

notes.title: The Withering 2.x Migration to Main Branch
notes.content:
The Withering 2.x Migration to Main Branch just went live!

Hello everybody!

As it was previously announced, the new stable Withering 2.x build is replacing the legacy 1.x build in the main branch!

Players who are opted to the default main branch will be getting the new 2.x build and all following updates. For players who want to gain access to the legacy 1.x build can do so by opting to the legacy branch. To opt to a legacy branch please follow the steps below:

1) In the Steam game library right click The Withering and select properties

2) In the properties window, switch to BETAS tab on top

3) Enter legacybranch in beta access code and click on Check Code

4) Select the Legacy branch from the drop down menu

Due to drastic differences in mechanics, the 2.x and 1.x builds are incompatible and the data will not be transferred. Please note that by opting to a legacy branch, you will not be getting any new updates.


The Withering 2.x new build information

With the new 2.x build, players will now have access to a brand new character system, inventory management, fluent camp management and other new features. The 2.0 update is focused on all of the new features we are introducing with it, please keep in mind that this is a work in progress and some of the gameplay elements are not yet implemented with this release.

The Camp
The 2.0 introducing a brand new camp gameplay with deep and fluent management system that is no longer a separate entity. In 2.0 players will dynamically move between the Camp and the rest of the world, while sharing the Camp features amongst all of the characters.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_1.jpg

The new Camp is a living entity, with vendors, quartermaster and survivors populating it. The entire system is managed from a single menu directly from the character interface, which allows players to transparently switch between characters in world and still have access to all of the camp features.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_12.jpg

The new interface allows players to manage all of the camp buildings, survivors and missions. Upgrade different structures and add-ons to gain multiple bonuses.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_13.jpg

All of the camp upgrades, add-ons and other types of improvements are now managed directly from the character control, through our new robust inventory and stats management system. These elements have a verity of bonuses and stats, rarities and more. There are many ways for players to receive these upgrades, and one them being crafting.

New Crafting System
Crafting! Yes, in 2.0 players will gain access to a new deep crafting system that is easily managed through the new character interface. The system is based on several types of crafting categories like Tools, Armor, Weapons, Gear with recipes available in each of these categories.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_9.jpg

More Crafting
2.0 also introduces the extended crafting mechanic that will mostly be used for constructing Camp upgrades and Add-ons, combine scavenged items into resource bundles or breaking down other types of items. This system will require players to assemble the recipe by dropping the items in appropriate slots. Different combinations will yield different results.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_11.jpg

Players will receive the recipes by different means, like completing a mission and getting a recipe as a reward, or simply by finding one while scavenging the world with their character.

NPCs
In 2.0 players will now have access to the new types of NPCs such as a camp vendor and a quartermaster. With our new character system players gain access to the trading system, each items now have value and can be sold or purchased from different vendors throughout the world.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_2.jpg

Some of these vendors will have specialty items that players will need for more advanced recipes or a special item bonus.

Another type of NPC introduced in 2.0 is the quartermaster. The quartermaster manages players storage, which is a shared repository available to all player characters.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_3.jpg

These NPCs can be found in different areas in the world and players will be able to access their storage by interacting with them, so the storage is no longer limited to only Camp gameplay.

Player Characters
The new character system in 2.0 allows player to fully customize the character stats through gear, equipment and other means. Characters now have multiple stats that are used through the gameplay for different purposes, like interacting with NPCs, scavenging, combat, etc..

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_5.jpg

One of the most important changes in 2.0's character management is that players are no longer limited to the four characters defined. Instead, players will be able to find new playable characters through out the gameplay, by using the radio communication from the camp, running missions, exploring the world, etc.

Each playable character will have a background story and unique looks. Once players add a new character to their roster, they can take switch between the characters at designated spots in the world or in their camp at will, and customize the character stats to their liking with different equipment sets. This allows players to have different types of characters for different situations in the game.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_9.jpg

One of such examples would be to have a character with high charisma and persuasion stats to use on diplomacy missions. And have another character to do the fighting.

Exploring and Scavenging
As it was mentioned above, players will now be able to fluently transition between the camp and the world map with any of their characters. This is done directly from the game world, by interacting with entry / exit points.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_4.jpg

These points will allow players to cross between maps, Camp, missions and other areas throughout the world with their active character.

Withering 2.0 introduces a brand new scavenging system that will take the experience to the next level!

Everything in the world now becomes a part of this scavenging system, and players will be able to interact with the in world objects. The system automatically highlights the objects that are available for scavenging.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_7.jpg

Different objects will yield different loot types and categories, such as components, resources, equipment and etc.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Screenshot_8.jpg

Scavenged objects will randomly respawn through out the world.

Feedback and Bug Reporting
Please leave your feedback regarding your gameplay experience and ideas in the following thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/427950/discussions/0/2741975115076574273/

Please feel free to ask questions in the thread as well.

notes.content:
The Withering Update 2.0.0.20 is now live!

Hello everybody! The 2.0.0.20 update has been silently rolled out last night. This update is focusing on preparation for the main branch migration, both technically and gameplay wise. The main branch migration is scheduled to happen on this upcoming weekend, and I will be posting another development update to address this migration in detail.


New Tutorials
With 2.0.0.20 update a new game tutorials are available to players. The new tutorials can be viewed by pressing the question mark icon on the top interface, and are focused on all the gameplay key elements and mechanics.

New Looting Mechanic
As it was requested multiple times by the community, a new quick loot mechanic has been implemented into the gameplay. Players can now scavenge nearby loot objects by pressing "F" key on a keyboard. Pressing "F" with a loot window open will loot all items and pressing "Esc" key will close the loot window.

notes.title: The Withering 2.0 - Development Update #3
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I would like to share some information with you in regards of the upcoming update and my plans for the next couple of weeks.

Personal Announcement
As I mentioned in one my previous announcements, for the past couple of weeks I was working on expanding the camp management gameplay elements, crafting mechanics / recipes and several other gameplay features, including the construction of the city map. I would like to share that development progress with you.

New Features
During this last engagement I was able to implement several new features that I am personally excited about:

Camp Management Missions
The camp management interface now have fully functioning missions that allow players to use the survivors favors. There are different mission types and each type has different survivor skill requirements, such as diplomacy, scavenging etc.. These missions will yield rewards based on the performance of the squad assigned. New items were added to the item database that are required for the mission control management.

Camp Management Economy
Another expansion of the camp management is the new economy type feature that allows players to choose their marketplace economy. Players can now choose what type of trading goods the marketplace produces, such as ammo, resources, fame or actual currency.

Crafting
I have also updated the crafting tables for existing and new items. Players can now craft melee weapons, new armor and other equipment. Another cool feature that I was able to work on is the assembly mechanic. Player can now break down resources into components that can be used for crafting. I will be expanding the assembly even further in the future.

Weapons
As a part of the item database expansion, new weapons were added and upgraded with new features. The new equipment (armor, weapons, trinkets) now have new stats that influence a character. New armor types focus on melee or ranged combat. Trinkets now have additional stats that influence combat, character stats (stamina and health regeneration) and several other stats that will be used in camp management gameplay.

Rarities and Specializations
The new weapons added to the database now have different rarities that influence weapon stats and performance. Additionally, several weapon variations were created to allow players to choose how they prefer to approach combat in the game. For example, three different variations of an AK-47 Assault rifle were created, one is a classic balanced weapon, the other is focused on critical chances and damage and another is focused on aggressive close combat with extended magazine and higher rate of fire. Other variations were created for different weapon types.

City Map
I am currently working on expanding the city map and designing a quarantine zone that will become a part of the city. I will be talking about the quarantine zone in more details in one of the future announcements.

Upcoming Update - Scheduling
I would still like to invest additional efforts in finalizing the development of the features that I mentioned above. It is a lot of work and a very time consuming process, but I am very happy with the results and keeping the development tight to the estimated time frame. 

I will be splitting the update into two parts and releasing the new camp features update by the middle of this week. And the city map expansion update will come shortly after, I estimate it to be ready by the end of this week or early next week.

Summary

Overall, the development is going very well and I was able to implement a lot of features during this last engagement. 

We are getting closer to the main branch merge with every day, but there are still several outstanding items that I would like to address before the main branch merge.

Some delays might be expected, but I have no reasons to believe that they will be drastic. Once the next two updates will be released, I'll be able to sit down and evaluate the next phase of the development to put together a schedule and time frame estimates.

Feedback

Please leave your thoughts, feedback and ideas in the following thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/427950/discussions/0/2741975115076574273/

Please feel free to ask questions in that thread as well.


Thank you!

notes.title: The Withering 2.0 - Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

It's been a very busy week and I am very happy with the results! I am slightly ahead of the estimated schedule with the development and the end result is better than I have anticipated!

I would like to share a few things with you on what was achieved in the past couple of weeks as well the plans for the near future.

Environment and HUD
The player HUD development was completed. HUD now fully functioning with the new player stats system and weapon display.

The following screenshots were taken from the new game environment that will become a part of the Withering 2.0 city map.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/CityWalk.jpg

Let's break it down a little bit. One of the major changes in 2.0 is the scale of the map. If we look at the buildings in the distance, they are over one thousand game units away from the character. Now to put it in perspective, the largest map in 1.x is currently Upper St.Claire section of the city. St.Claire is built on a 500x500 game units map. What we see on the screenshot above is twice the size of an entire St.Claire map.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/CityWalk2.jpg

Let's talk a little bit about performance and optimization. I was able to develop a more advanced level design approach that allows for the same amount of details to be implemented while costing less resources. This also allowed for a larger scale construction. In addition, new features were developed such as cloth behavior emulation is now controlled via shaders rather than physics engine, and as such will reduce the processing cost and increase an overall performance. New improvements were also implemented for particle systems and other gameplay elements.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/CityWalk3.jpg

My initial internal testing yielded a much better results in comparison to the 1.x build. This testing was done BEFORE the major optimizations are applied. I am expecting an even better results once the map is fully constructed and optimized.

notes.title: The Withering 2.0.0.3 Update
notes.content:
The Withering 2.0.0.3 update is now live!

General Information
Hello everybody! In this update I am introducing the new combined character controller into the gameplay. The new functionality consists of all three previously separate controller states, unarmed, melee and gunplay. The new controller functionality now combines all three states into one.

In addition, the new controller now fully supports the coexistence of the 2.0 character / item stats system. This introduces an enormous verity to the gameplay. As well as opens the door to additional features that will further expand the gameplay elements for the players.

The demo scene has been adjusted and players can now engage in both melee and gunfight combat with enemies being re-spawned across the map.

Important Information
Currently there are several elements still being developed for the new controller. The ability to switch directly between Melee state and Gunplay state is one of them. Players are still able to do that with the current controller version, but it requires to switch the combat mode off and on again.

The controller functionality will be expanded in the next update and it will fully support the direct transition between these states. As well as a fully functioning HUD. The new HUD will reflect the character vital stats such as health, stamina and fatigue, as well as have a fully detailed weapon display functionality.

Melee combat stats
With this new update, melee combat is being expanded to support the weapon stats. Each melee weapon now has combat stats such as damage, critical hit chance and critical hit damage. In addition, the heavy strikes now deal higher damage to enemies.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Thumbnail.jpg

The melee combat mechanic has been upgraded to fully support these stats or any stats that will be added down the road.

Firearms combat stats
In addition to the melee stats expansion, the gunplay mechanic has been upgraded as well. Several firearm weapons have been added to the game and players can try them out in the demo scene.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/NewGunplayController.jpg

Each firearm now has the following stats that have been fully integrated in the gameplay mechanic:

# Damage
# Critical Hit Chance
# Critical Hit Damage Multiplier
# Accuracy
# Stability

The last two stats work together to introduce an additional weapon control mechanic into the gameplay. Accuracy is governing the precision of each shot. Each following shot will be slightly less accurate as the weapon kicks, and this is where Stability weapon stat will dictate how fast the accuracy will be regained. For example, firing a long burst with a fully automatic weapon will suffer accuracy penalty with each shot. But bursts with a short pause between them will allow the weapon to be stabilized and suffer less accuracy penalty. Stability is critical for both, automatic and semi automatic weapons.

Next Update Planned Features
In the next update I plan to have the new controller functionality to be fully implemented and finalized.

The new player HUD will be added.

The construction of the new playable environment will begin.

http://steamcommunity.com/app/427950/discussions/0/2741975115076574273/

Please feel free to ask questions in that thread as well.


Thank you!

notes.content:
The Withering 2.0 Update is now live!

Personal announcement
Hello everybody! Oh, where to begin..? I guess I'll start from the beginning. When I originally introduced The Withering to the world through Steam Greenlight program, I had a vision, I wanted the game to bring something new to the genre. Being a gamer and a fan of the survival games, I wanted to expand the gameplay elements that I felt were lacking in many games. While we achieved a lot during the last year, I still did not feel like we are in the place I have envisioned.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0.0 is going live soon!

The wait is finally over and we are happy to announce that our first part of the major update is about to go live! In this update we are introducing a lot of changes as well as new gameplay elements.

New Camp Management gameplay

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/NewCampManagement1.jpg

The brand new Camp Management gameplay allows players to explore their survivors camp with their Leader character. Players are now able to walk around the camp and access all of the management features directly from the third person. The general management interface is also available to players, at anytime by pressing "O" on the keyboard.

http://cmsoftworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/NewCampManagement7.jpg

We will be expanding the new camp management gameplay with additional features in our future updates, such as camp population, player characters and defense gameplay mechanics.

New Free Roam map

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_7.jpg

The new Free Roam map is also a part of this update. Players will now be able to explore the new Utah State map with all of the locations from the previous version of the free roam available. 

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_9.jpg

We are going to expand the new Free Roam map with additional features mentioned in our previous announcements.

*Important Information*

Due to the fact that a lot of changes were introduced with this update under the hood, players might encounter minor issues in this release. We are aware of most of them and are going to address them in our upcoming patches.

The new player controller will feel different than the previous version, and some of the functionality might not be as smooth. We are constantly working on improving this and plan to have a more polished version of the controller by the time of the Multiplayer release.

The new Free Roam map is also a work in progress and will be expanded with the new locations, missions and features such as reputation vendors and Factions gameplay elements in the future updates.

Please keep in mind that your feedback and bug reporting play a very important part in the development process. Players are strongly encouraged to report any issues they are encountering during the gameplay.

Thank you!

notes.title: Free Roam: Development update #3
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I know it's been quiet for a while, and I am very excited to announce that we are nearing a major update release!

We had a special team meeting this Friday where we were discussing the strategy for rolling out the major update as well as preliminary release date. The good news is we will be able to release the update in two phases. The first phase will include the new Free Roam map with all of the locations transferred from the previous Free Roam. This phase will also include the new Camp Management gameplay where players will be able to explore their camps with their leader characters. The new controller will also become a part of the update.

The first phase update is currently scheduled for roll out approximately two weeks from now on Jan 10th.

The second phase of the update will be the long awaited Multiplayer update. That will allow players to play in a Co-Op Multiplayer mode. Upon release the Multiplayer features will be limited to Missions only. And we plan to expand the functionality to Free Roam shortly after the second phase roll out scheduled for Jan 24th.

I will be posting development updates on a weekly basis at this point and share the new screens from the upcoming gameplay, as well as talk about the features in more details!

Happy Holidays everybody!
Crochan.

------------------

Update: Jan 11

Hello everybody! We are still working on the update and ran into some minor hardware issues at the studio, that unfortunately caused an unexpected delay. The update is going to happen early next week, I'll announce the exact date this weekend.

Thank you.

notes.title: New Camp Management Gameplay - Development Update #1
notes.content:
Overview

Hello everybody,

As I have mentioned before in my previous announcement and comments here on the community HUB, we are working on a brand new Camp Management gameplay functionality. The new gameplay will allow players to take control of the leader and visit the camp.

In this announcement I will be talking about some of the features that will be presented with this new gameplay, functionality that will become available shortly with our upcoming update, and the final vision of the camp management as we want it to be down the road.

Most of the heavy lifting is already behind us as we have expanded our Environment Manager system responsible for day / night cycle, visual and audio effects (and weather control in a near future), to operate in the turn based camp management gameplay. Below you can see the screen taken directly from the game engine editor as we are reconstructing the camp. There is not much to see, since the majority of work were done in code, but I still wanted to share these with you, so we all can be on the same page.

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/037/251/c426de2cf77c099ab75110d74cea5e75_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1475991530&auto=format&q=92&s=368eae4c413005f77c973045fb85f7b9

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/037/254/2d1ea78a81871f4ceae7e1b51fffc777_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1475991545&auto=format&q=92&s=ac2aa4803396156c6442c9315939e4dc

Upcoming features

In the next update players will be able to visit and explore the camp, all of the currently implemented features will be available in the new gameplay, with a possible exception of the defense gameplay elements as these will still need to undergo major restructuring.

notes.title: Free Roam: Development update # 3
notes.content:
Hello everybody, it's been another very busy week for us here and I would like to share a few very important things with you! In this announcement I will be talking about the Free Roam gameplay updates coming our way as well as a short term road map regarding the new features.

Free Roam overview

First I would like to thank you all for your feedback! You have been a great help and because of this active community we can now identify and improve the gameplay experience.

I would like to start with my personal observation and experience with the new Free Roam gameplay. During the last week I was heavily involved in breaking down the gameplay and reviewing the feedback from the community. And personally, I felt that the gameplay was lacking in several aspects. The free roam section map did not capture the feeling of the open space and was heavy on the machine resource consumption. The overall experience playing the free roam map did not deliver what we were aiming for and it was something I was not comfortable with!

We put our heads together, and worked even harder on improving both of these aspects of the gameplay and I am very happy to announce that we have made great progress!

The screenshots below will show you the newly developed Free Roam Utah State section:

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_1.jpg

We were able to create a map that captures the essence of the open world gameplay. Vast planes, mountains and forests now cover the land that is four times larger than the previously introduced section.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_2.jpg

These new developments allowed us to invest even more details into the living world of the game. Each location (node) that is spread across a huge terrain will have additional sub nodes that will be governed by the location state.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_3.jpg

The sub nodes will be randomly spawned in the area governed by the primary location (like the farm in the screenshots) and those sub nodes can vary between scavenging sites, bandit or survivor camps, resource drops, random events, missions and more..

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_4.jpg

The Faction controlled locations will have reputation vendors that players can purchase resources, materials and equipment from by spending the faction reputation currency gained from tasks and events.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_5.jpg

Players will have to maintain the control of the locations and help faction NPCs fend off the infected and bandits. Should the location fall into bandit hands or be overrun by the infected, the sub nodes related to that location will be less frequently spawned until the location is liberated again.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_6.jpg

This is just one example of the upcoming features that we plan to implement into the new gameplay. We plan to have these features gradually added onto the free roam gameplay in our weekly updates.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_7.jpg

The new free roam will feature all of the locations present on the current section as well as several new ones.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_8.jpg

The day night cycle will be revised respectively to the new free roam section size.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_9.jpg

We are in our final stages of the dynamic world loading system and we plan to implement it with the new Free Roam section release.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/UtahStateFR_10.jpg

I will be posting updates as we progress through the development and talk about the features I have mentioned here in more details soon!

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.0.31.2
notes.content:
Update 1.0.31.2 is now live!

In this update we are introducing the new Free Roam gameplay element as well as the new camp interface which will allow players to easily travel to existing sites and the new Free Roam map.

Utah State east

The new Utah State east Free Roam section featured in this update is available for exploration in full. The section is still a work in progress and that means that players might encounter some raw areas (flat landscapes for examples). However, most of the locations planned are already present on the section, with several more to be added in upcoming updates.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/UtahEast004.jpg

Currently there is no "Map" available and we plan to implement it in our next update along with additional navigation features such as highway signs and dynamic region names as it is present on St.Claire site. To help players navigate the new Free Roam section we recommend to stick to the main highway as it circles an entire section and is linked to all of the locations.

The section is yet to undergo optimization both performance and memory consumption wise. We plan to have most of the optimization implemented with our next update as well as adding additional options to the menu which will allow players more control over the terrain details and balance the performance vs quality even more.

This new gameplay element opens a doorway to a lot of new features that we want to add, including vehicles and faction missions. These features will be gradually added on a weekly basis updated.

Our lead programmer Oleksii Myrgulskyi and his team is currently working on a new feature that will allow us to dynamically manipulate the sections of the game world. This complex system will lay a foundation for the seamless open world section transition, allowing us to create much larger sections without consuming additional resources or causing an impact on performance.

New Interface

The new deployment interface has been implemented.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/NewCampInterface02.jpg

It is accessible from the Main Camp interface and it allows players to travel to all of the existing sites and the new Free Roam section.

Additional Information
This is the first major update we are releasing since the beginning of the Early Access and your feedback is very important to us. Please keep in mind that all of the features introduced are still being developed, and will be improved with upcoming updates. Players are strongly encouraged to report any issues or problems.

I am opening a new pinned discussion thread on the forum dedicated to the Free Roam gameplay. Please post your comments and finding there.

Thank you!

notes.title: Free Roam: Development update #1
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

I am super excited to let you know that the Free Roam development is going very well! These last few days were extremely productive, we have added several more locations to explore on the map and I am personally very happy with the internal testing results so far.

Before writing this I decided to do a little run around the map, to be exact just the main perimeter highway that circles it, started the stop watch on my phone and started sprinting.. By the time I have reached the point where I stared, the stop watch counter was 30:46.7 , It took me more than half an hour real life time just to run around the map on a main highway, without stopping at any location anytime. And I haven't gone in a middle of the map yet, just circled it.

One of the best things I have noticed, is that I never was "In the middle of nowhere" for more than a minute at a time. There was always something coming up on the horizon. Personally I like the concept of huge maps, but I don't really enjoy walking / running simulators. So I think we have nailed it in that aspect. The map is a very decent size, and you don't have to run for 15 minutes just to reach a site you want to scavenge or explore.

And this is just a quarter of the Utah state that we are planning to implement into the game for players to explore. And yes, then we will do the rest of the states..

I will be making a short video showing you a little bit of the gameplay on the new map and how the interface in the camp will change for deploying to real time action gameplay, sometime this week. As soon as I will get a chance to record it.

Thank you all for your support and feedback, you keep us inspired!

notes.title: Update 1.0.30.5
notes.content:
Update 1.0.30.5 is now live!

In this update we introduce new "The Den" mission accessible from Woodsfield Upper St.Claire Site. In addition new visual effects have been added to enhance the combat experience. Bandit AI cover based behavior has been adjusted for better performance, along with other performance optimizations.

Under Fire

New stunning visual effects have been added to enhance the look and feel of the fire fight combat when engaging bandits. New realistic muzzle flash effects with gun barrels spitting out flames, smoke and heat blurring.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/NewEffects04.jpg

New bullet trace and bullet impact effects truly take the overall combat experience to a new level. Each engagement becomes an adrenaline pumping thrill as players dodge to cover with bullets whizzing all around.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/NewEffects05.jpg

Bullet impacts sending pieces of concrete, brick, wood chips and dust flying through the air.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/NewEffects03.jpg

Ripping covers in bursting dust explosions with our new precise bullet impact detection system, makes each effect align with the direction of the surface it hits making the effects look even more realistic.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/NewEffects02.jpg

Material based bullet decals system with material surface based detection.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/NewEffects01.jpg



The Den

notes.title: Update 1.0.27.8
notes.content:
Update 1.0.27.8 is now live!

In this update we introduce new mechanics as well as address the issues that were discovered during internal testing and reported by the community.

Weapon Maintenance
Players will now be able to repair their weapons with a new "Parts" component that can be acquired by dismantling items. Most of the items players will find in game will now yield parts. Destroying items has been replaced with Dismantling. Take apart the weapons you don't need and fix the ones you do. Now that this new mechanic is in place, we are going to work on expanding it's functionality further.

Rare means rare!
With new repair system in place, we are dropping the rarity chances of the items in world. Hold on to your Legendries it will not be that easy to find them now.

Be quick or be dead
We are also introducing the new "Quick Heal" mechanic. The quick heal (C by default) will consume one Medkit from the player's inventory and apply the healing effect with a special bonus that comes from the new backpacks and in the future from other new gear elements. The reason for quick heal to consume just the medkits is due to the fact that we are going to revise other healing items effect once we expand the weapon system class. Other healing items will take care of various negative effects such as bleeding for example. In addition the healing cool down is now active after using a healing item or quick heal, the cool down icon is displayer on the bottom left interface.

Preparation is everything
Players can now find the new backpacks we are introducing with this update throughout the world. These new backpacks will be replacing the ones currently present, and have additional bonuses. Currently the new backpacks provide a healing bonus, which depends on the rarity of the backpack. In the near future more bonuses will be added to the mix.

Duck and Cover, everywhere
Bandits will now use cover everywhere and not just on Graham Street Tunnel mission. We are still working on this functionality and will work on improving the AI behavior as well as add new combat mechanics and teach the enemies to suppress player's position and flank.

Patch Notes:

Fixed: Production Interface did not play sounds at proper volume
Adjusted: Reloading a weapon from hip fire mode will extend it's duration
Adjusted: Bandits will now use cover everywhere
Adjusted: Ammo stacks capacity increased
Added: Dismantle mechanic
Added: Repair mechanic
Added: New backpacks and bonuses
Added: Quick Heal mechanic
Added: Healing cool down

notes.title: Pack your bags, we are going outdoors!
notes.content:
Upcoming new free roam map
Hello everybody!

It's yet another weekend of a very busy week and I just wanted to share a few things you. I have noticed that more and more people are wondering about the open world features that we promised you, and wanted to shed some light on the development process in that department.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/WildernessSunset.jpg

We are working on our first free roam section of Utah state, that we plan to make available by the end of June. This is the very first of the four sections that players will be able to explore. Players will be able to transition between the sections without having to return to camp. Each section will hold a lot of activities for players to participate in. Missions, bounty hunts, etc.. In each section of the state a controlling faction will have a safe stronghold where players will be able to trade their reputation for unique rewards and gear, ammo, medicine and more. Our beloved city of Woodsfield will also be directly accessible from the free roam mode.

Vehicles, missions, storyline, community activities, achievements, new equipment, character skill trees.. I can really talk for hours on how many possibilities and new features this will add to the gameplay, so I will be posting weekly updates on the development process.

Thank you all and have a great weekend!

notes.title: Update 1.0.25.5
notes.content:
Update 1.0.25.5 is now live!

Update Information
Hello everybody! I would like to talk a little about this update and the features that we are introducing with it. If you have followed us on our Community HUB, you probably know that we are introducing a first out of many missions that will be available for players to take on from the real time action gameplay St.Claire Site map, the Graham Street Tunnel.

Tunnel Screenshot
http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/GrahamStreetTunnel.jpg

These missions will challenge players to an objective based play through with unique enemies and loot. I am personally very excited about this new mechanic, mostly because it opens a lot of doors for us to make the gameplay experience diverse and exciting.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/GrahamStreetTunnel2.jpg

We are also introducing a new elite enemy system, these elite enemies are tougher and have a greater chances for rare loot. The objective based system will now allow us to create random encounters throughout the maps where players will have to take on different assignments and receive various rewards, and so much more!

Players will be able to transition to the missions from a designated places on the map (and an instance menu once more missions will become available) and return to the map once the mission is complete, or go directly back to camp.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/GrahamStreetTunnelEntrance.jpg

In addition to all the features mentioned above, we have also implemented a new enemy identification visual system. Players will now be able to see the enemy details when aiming at them. Their health bar, enemy type and name. Elite enemy's health bar will appear in golden color.

We plan to release additional missions with every second update or more frequently if possible. Also, the mechanic is still fresh and it will be polished as well as expanded with new features in the future.


Chop `Em Up!
A new melee weapon is joining the arsenal:
http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/Machete.png

The new Kukri machete can now be found in supply crates and as a mission reward!

New Wardrobe
New outfits are now available for players to wear, some of these outfits can be found in supply crates throughout the St.Claire Site map or can be a part of the mission special rewards.

Update Notes:

Added: New melee Kukuri machete
Added: New outfits
Added: Graham Street Tunnel mission
Added: Elite enemy system
Added: New objective based gameplay system
Added: Visual enemy identification system

notes.title: Update 1.0.17.7
notes.content:
Update 1.0.17.7 is now live!

In this update we bring you the much awaited new gameplay elements that you have been asking for! The new South St.Claire region of the City of Woodsfield has been extended with new sections and new enemies are now roaming the streets!


Bandits
Players will encounter a new threat! Bandits and looters are now roaming the streets of South St Claire, making scavenging more challenging for the players. Armed with different weapons, these guys will shoot to kill.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Bandits001.png

Grab your best weapon, stack up on ammo and make sure to have extra medicine in your backpacks. You will be facing several enemies at a time, so using cover is critical for survival. Don't be a hero! Confronting bandits in open combat will most likely result in your demise. Use the environment to your advantage, and gain an upper hand.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Bandits002.png

Bandits will drop loot on death that has an increased chance of item rarity and yield higher experience than infected.

South St Claire
The region have been expanded with new sections and bandit spawn points have been place throughout the site. This site will be expanded in every update and players should expect to see new environments.

What to expect next
New bandit models and enemy levels such as regular, elite and boss enemies with increased rewards. New environments will become available for players to explore, like subways and sewers, that will hold new infected enemy types. Reputation mechanism, that will allow players to gain reputation with one of the factions and spend it on unique faction rewards. Female player characters will become available soon.


Patch Notes:

Fixes: Binoculars descripting in production menu
Fixed: Delay after reloading
Fixed: Rendering performance issues
Fixed: Adjusted handgun animations
Fixed: Vsync would not trigger properly sometimes

! IMPORTANT INFORMATION !
The new enemy AI is still in development, there are a few issues that we are aware of and are working on fixing them. Players might experience several camera positioning issues during crouch state, we are going to address this issue in our next update.

Stay tuned for more information on the upcoming features. Players are encouraged to report any issues they encounter on the new site as well as overall performance.

Thank you!

The new South St.Claire region of the City of Woodsfield is being included in the update in the beta state. Players are encouraged to report any issues they encounter on the new site as well as overall performance.


South St.Claire
The South St.Claire region of Woodsfield mostly consists of a dense residential, commercial and industrial districts that are linked together with a series of highways and subway lines. The new site will be featuring some of the new elements that players will be encountering and this site will become a part of the multiplayer update.

Multiplayer Preparation
Players might discover multiplayer elements in the new site while exploring, these elements are currently disabled until the multiplayer update becomes available.

Patch Notes:

Fixes:

Fixed: Jumping from crouch position results in unexpected character behavior
Fixed: Enemies will no longer spawn next to player characters

This update addresses the issues that were discovered during the internal testing and / or reported by the community. New features are being included with this update, please see the detailed description below.


The New Features
In this update we are introducing new visuals into the game. The new effects are designed to enhance the overall quality on Ultra settings and add new post effect settings to the video options menu, these effects are optional and can be turned on and off independently on any quality setting. In the following screenshot you can see the new features in effect in combination with Ultra settings.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/Barricade.jpg


The screenshots were taken from the new site that is in development, and will be featured in one of our upcoming updates with our new enemies and multiplayer content. The depth of field effect adds a feeling of depth to the objects in the background and a smoothing fog in the distance adds to the overall environment effect.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/Square.jpg

A lot of work was done on optimization side of both, the new site and general performance. Our internal tests show an increase on both high end and low end machines. We will be adding the new site in a beta state with our upcoming update, where players are strongly encouraged to report the performance on their side.

We are also adding more features on the gameplay side, such as dynamic crosshairs, areas monitor and additional on screen GUI information that will help players keep better track of their progress.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/Headshot.jpg

Players can expect to visit new places on the new upcoming site. Abandoned diners, ruins, slums and underground subway stations are just a few of those.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/Diner.jpg

The streets are filled with remains of the struggle against the infection during the initial outbreak and players will be engaged in a brand new gameplay elements, interact with the environment and gain special reputation bonuses with the controlling faction in the region.

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/SideStreet.jpg

Multiplayer Gamemode - Closed Beta
We will be announcing a Closed Beta date for the multiplayer game mode soon! If you already own The Withering, you will have a chance to register for the closed beta and work close together with the development team on improving the experience.

Fixed: Key binding not working properly while in camp
Fixed: Action buttons on the right panel interface in camp being pushed off screen in some cases

Added: Depth of Field effect
Added: Crease Shading effect

Added: Fog

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/VideoOptions.jpg

Gameplay:

Added: Dynamic crosshairs
Added: Player location tracking mechanism (will become available with a new site)

notes.title: Update 1.0.11.11
notes.content:
Update 1.0.11.11 is now live!

This update addresses the issues that were discovered during the internal testing and / or reported by the community. The new SkyWay site is a part of this update. Several gameplay features and elements have been revised. Please see the patch notes below for additional details.

The new Site is here!

http://thewitheringpc.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/NewSite_002.jpg
The new SkyWay site is now available for players to explore. This site is focused more on action gameplay style, and more gear is available to loot. Players will also have a chance of finding materials, resources and survivors while exploring.


Patch Notes: 

Fixes: 

Fixed: More than one construction mission can be started
Fixed: Animation being broken when switching weapons during reloading
Fixed: Aborting a scavenging missions sometimes results in mission hanging
Fixed: Aiming animation angle degree was off

Gameplay: 

Adjusted: Losing all survivors will no longer end the game
Adjusted: SMGs visual effects revised
Adjusted: Melee (Right + Left) combo speed adjusted
Added: Weapon mods confirmation and replacement mechanism
Added: Spawn item rotation mechanism
Added: Infected model variations
Added: Locations now have information on resources in description
Added: New SkyWay Site


! IMPORTANT INFORMATION !

Losing in a raid or other cases where no survivors are left alive will no longer end the game, instead the camp will enter a state where it will be losing resources every phase. Players will be able to regroup with leader character and travel to either one of the sites in an attempt to find survivors and reestablish their camp.

Items dropped on the ground by players will be deleted after 2 minutes.

We would love to get feedback from players regarding the design and gameplay on the new site. Also please let us know if you are experiencing any of the mentioned issues after this update. 

Thank you!

notes.title: Pitch Your Ideas to Us !
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

I'm happy to announce that our Feedbacks and Ideas engine is up and running on our website. We want you to step up and let us know which features you would like to see implemented into the game first.

 Instructions 

How to pitch your idea:

1) Click the link:  Ideas link  

2) Click on the Feedbacks & Ideas banner on the left side of the screen

3) Enter a distinctive name for the idea you would like to pitch

4) Enter a detailed description with as much information as possible

5) Enter your email address

6) Enter your name

7) Press "Post"


How to vote:

1) Click the link:  Ideas link  

2) Click on the Feedbacks & Ideas banner on the left side of the screen

3) Select the idea from the list of ideas on the left and read the description

4) Click the "Vote" button on top left


And that's it, it's as simple as that !

This event will be going for a couple of weeks, after that we will close the voting and gather information. The ideas that will have most votes will become a priority in our development process and will be scheduled for the next major update.

Meanwhile we will be working on the new features that were already scheduled, and will be monitoring the community feedback and bug reports. Any critical issues will be prioritized and dealt with in patches and updates.

Thank you all for your support !

notes.title: Early Access is Here !
notes.content:
Hello everybody !

I'm VERY excited to announce that "The Withering" is now officially in Early Access release state !

I would like to personally thank the Steam Green light community for support of our project, and feedback ! It has been a very exciting experience for us here at CM Softworks.

There is still a lot of work to be done, but personally I think we made a huge step today. The Early Access release will have elements of Turn Based management gameplay and the Real Time Action gameplay mode as well. Here is the list of some features that are available to players in the Early Access:

* Single Player Mode
* Custom Character Creation
* Camp Management Gameplay mode
* Real Time Action Gameplay mode
* A special outfit has been included for the early access available from character creation screen!

The following features are planned to be implemented in the next major update, that is scheduled to come out in the first half of 2016:

* Multiplayer Mode
* PvP Game mode
* Co-op Game Mode
* Additional game content such as new maps, outfits, weapons
* Management and Real time action game modes features
* New enemy types
* New events

And more..

I hope I have answered some of your questions that you probably have, please see our Early Access information on the store page for additional information regarding the game.

Thank you all !

David.
